title: Neon Requiem: Final Show (Bootleg DVD) - The Last Performance - Mostly Crying Audio
subtitle: The Last Performance - Mostly Crying Audio
body: The legendary final show of Neon Requiem, recorded on a phone from the back of The Underground. Audio quality is mostly sobbing from the audience. Video is shaky because the camera person was also crying. Historic.
summary: Bootleg DVD of Neon Requiem's legendary final show at The Underground. 2 hours 47 minutes. Audio: 60% music, 40% tears.

features: Includes 13 encore attempts before band broke down
Special feature: Mars's eulogy for the band
Not authorized but honestly pretty good

comments.content:
This is unauthorized but honestly it's pretty good

Look, I should probably take legal action but... they captured something real here. The crying. The desperation. The 13 encore attempts. It's art. Buy it.

comments.content:
Audio quality: tears. Video quality: also tears.

You can't see much because everyone was crying. You can't hear much because everyone was crying. But you can FEEL everything. That's what Neon Requiem was about.
